title: Some gameplay after 1 month development
author: Cosmonan
selftext:
Made some changes after the visual feedback from here (thanks guys) and fixed : sprite contact shadows (were too weak and blurry) and added an outline world shader so the 3D world talks to the sprites, which have outline. What do you guys think?

Game is a turn based dungeon crawler (mystery dungeon style).

comments.author: kesoju83
comments.body: This looks like a lot of fun! I really like the character designs. How did you create the sprites?

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body:
Thank you, my friend, really glad you enjoyed the visuals!
All sprites were made using Pixel Lab MCP with Claude Code working as QA/QC. For the characters I had to actually edit them in Aseprite after generated, since 8 direction with animation can get messy fast.

I still plan on remaking some enemies though.

comments.author: aarontrimble
comments.body: Ooh, I really like the perspective and vibe. Trying to create an environment with some of these similarities in my own game. What size pixel canvas to your characters occupy? 64x64?

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body:
Thank youuu, it means a lot to me!
Yep, 64x64 for the sprites.

comments.author: soulo222
comments.body: Looks good but get rid of the depth of field which messes with the clarity

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Oh yeah, I forgot to turn this off before recording, but yeah, I olan on getting rid of it.

comments.author: FilipeDM
comments.body: How do you manage to do the walking cycle so well?

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Been using Pixel Lab character generator and animation creator. A lot of cleaning up still needs to be done in Aseprite though.

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Sort of. The Mystery Dungeon genre is derived from traditional roguelikes. It plays similarly, but focus more on the tactical aspect of combat and item use than all the infinite possibilities of traditional roguelike (even though it is technically infinite as well, but traditional roguelikes usually have many more mechanics).

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Hmkay, Ragnarok was not a reference, sorry. Look up Shiren The Wanderer, Shattered Pixel Dungeon and Pokemon Mystery Dungeon. Those reflect better this kinda of niche!

replies.author: Apart-Imagination393
replies.body: hmm for the AI probably was lmao

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Probably not in this case as my sprites are 64x64 while Ragnarok uses 128x128, but yeah, you probably could say that about a lot of things anyways.
